svg.title: How Blindfill and Confidential Trenches fit together
svg.desc: Apps call the kit's one public entry. Your device holds the 12 words and wallet keys, keeps private notes, proves before the tap and checks every quote; orders signed ahead are coming soon. Helpers carry messages and hold no money keys. On chain, nothing has a key: the NEAR vault is the USDC cash home, and a pool on Solana, Base and Robinhood Chain approves every deposit itself and pays only the wallet a proof names. A fresh wallet signs one transaction: the pool checks the proof, pays it, and it buys; a sell goes back into the pool as a new note. NEAR Intents moves every dollar that changes chain. The exit tool brings money home with only the 12 words and public RPCs.
svg.text: The signing page, on its own address
Keys are made here and never leave
the USDC cash home, on NEAR
A pool on every chain you trade on
No key, no admin, no upgrade, no pause
and pays only the wallet a proof names
Money rests here, outside NEAR Intents
Your 12 words and public RPCs, no server of ours
